title: Inventive AI vs Steerlab: AI RFP Software Comparison (2026)
summary: Compare Inventive AI and Steerlab on AI response generation, proposal workflows, content governance, pricing, security, and customer reviews.
body_markdown:
Comparing Inventive AI vs Steerlab comes down to more than a feature list. Most teams ask, *how does each tool handle knowledge accuracy, how much manual editing does response require, and how well does it fit into your existing workflow?* Both tools cover[RFP](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/rfp-response-process-guide) response, but they work differently. This comparison breaks down how each one works so you can match the right tool to your team's needs.


**TLDR:**


- **Knowledge retrieval:** Inventive AI generates responses from connected company knowledge, while Steerlab relies on a curated proposal content library.
- **Workflow:** Inventive AI automates more of the response process with AI agents and human approvals. Steerlab focuses on AI-assisted drafting and team-led reviews.
- **Content governance:** Inventive AI automatically identifies outdated and conflicting content. Steerlab relies on manual review and content maintenance.
- **Security:** Both platforms are SOC 2 Type II compliant. Steerlab also advertises ISO 27001 compliance and GDPR readiness.


## **What Is Steerlab?**


Steerlab is AI proposal software designed for[presales](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/rfp-ai-resp-for-solutions-teams) , proposal, and security teams that want to respond to[RFPs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/rfp-management) using reusable company content.


The platform generates draft responses from a managed Q/A library, supports collaborative review workflows, and helps teams respond to structured questionnaires and narrative proposals. It also supports exports in Word, Excel, and PDF formats.


## **What Is Inventive AI?**


Inventive AI is an autonomous AI agentic platform for responding to RFPs,[RFIs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/rfi-request-for-information)[DDQs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/ddq-due-diligence-questionnaires) , and[security questionnaires.](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/ai-security-questionnaire-software) It automates the end-to-end response process while keeping humans in the loop for approvals.


Built from the ground up for AI, Inventive AI connects directly to your company's knowledge and uses specialized AI agents to retrieve information, generate responses, govern content, and support proposal reviews. The result is less manual coordination and more time spent improving proposal quality.


## **Feature Comparison: Inventive AI vs Steerlab**


### **AI Response Generation and Accuracy**


Steerlab generates draft responses using approved answers from your proposal library. When a new RFP comes in, AI searches that library for matching content, so the quality of each response depends on how well your library is maintained.


Inventive AI generates responses using your latest company knowledge, including product documentation, past RFPs, approved messaging, and connected business systems. Every response includes source citations and confidence scores, making it easier for reviewers to verify what AI generated.


### **Knowledge Management and Content Governance**


Inventive AI connects with systems like SharePoint, Google Drive, Confluence, Notion, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, and Okta, so teams can use the knowledge they already have. Its Content Governance Agent automatically flags outdated, duplicate, and conflicting responses before they appear in a proposal.


Steerlab stores approved responses in a centralized proposal library. Teams are responsible for reviewing and updating that content so AI continues generating accurate responses.


### **Context Engine**


Inventive AI uses information about each opportunity, such as the customer's industry, priorities, and requirements, to tailor responses automatically. That helps proposal teams avoid rewriting the same answers for every deal.


Steerlab starts with approved content from the proposal library. Proposal writers then edit those responses to match each customer's requirements.


### **Strategic Agents and Workflow Automation**


Inventive AI runs purpose-built AI agents, each covering a distinct stage of the proposal workflow: content governance, competitive intelligence, and response analysis. Steerlab's workflow is built around retrieving approved content from the stored library when a new RFP arrives.


#### **What Inventive AI's Agents Actually Do**


- The Content Governance Agent monitors your content library, flags outdated answers, and suggests updates without manual audits.
- The Competitor Intelligence Agent pulls in real-time data on competing vendors so differentiators reflect current market positioning.
- The Response Analyzer Agent checks the entire response for compliance, missing requirements, contradictions, and tone and voice consistency before submission.


Steerlab's workflow is built around content retrieval. When an RFP comes in, the system surfaces relevant approved responses from the library. Proposal writers review, select, and assemble content before submission. SME reviews and approvals are coordinated within the tool's built-in collaboration features.


### **Security and Compliance**


Inventive AI is SOC 2 Type II certified, uses role-based access controls, and doesn't use customer data to train AI models. This helps organizations protect sensitive proposal information while meeting enterprise security requirements.


Steerlab is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and supports GDPR compliance for organizations handling proposal and customer data.


### **Ease of Use**


Inventive AI is rated 9/10 for ease of use on G2 and holds the[#1 spot for easiest-to-use RFP software in its category.](https://www.g2.com/categories/rfp?tab=easiest_to_use) Reviewers frequently mention the intuitive interface, responsive support, and how quickly teams can start responding by connecting their existing knowledge sources.


Steerlab also receives positive feedback for its simple interface and quick onboarding. Teams can upload previous proposals and start building a reusable content library without a lengthy implementation.


### **Pricing**


Inventive AI uses **volume-based pricing** for RFPs and security questionnaires, with **unlimited users and no per-seat fees** . Plans start at **$830/month, billed annually** .


Steerlab offers custom pricing based on your team's size and expected usage. Pricing isn't publicly available, so you'll need to contact the sales team for a quote.

## **Strengths and Limitations of Inventive AI and Steerlab**


### **Inventive AI**


**Strengths**


- Intuitive from day one. G2 users say the interface is easy to pick up without training, even for first-time users handling complex RFPs and DDQs.
- Cuts response time from days to hours. Users report completing RFPs in a few hours instead of several days, with the AI pulling context directly from connected sources like[Google Drive](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/google-drive-rfp-automation) ,[Confluence](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/confluence-rfp-automation) ,[Notion](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/notion-rfp-automation) ,[Salesforce](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/salesforce-rfp-automation) ,[HubSpot](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/hubspot-for-rfp-automation) , and[SharePoint](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/sharepoint-rfp-automation) .
- Accurate, context-rich responses. Users note that responses align with company tone, messaging, and compliance requirements, with each answer citing its source and showing a confidence score.
- Consistent messaging across all submissions. G2 reviewers credit the tool with keeping responses on-brand and consistent, which they associate with improved win rates.
- SOC 2 Type II certified with role-based access controls and a strict no-training-on-customer-data policy.
- Content Governance Agent flags stale or conflicting answers across connected sources automatically, without manual audits.


**Limitations**


- Reporting and analytics are limited. G2 reviewers flag a lack of customizable dashboards and filters for tracking team productivity and content performance trends.
- Reporting depth is a recurring ask. Users want better visual representations of data and more granular insights into submission outcomes.
- No mobile app currently available. Users working on the go have flagged the absence of a dedicated mobile experience.
- Jira integration is not yet live, which affects teams that manage proposal workflows inside project management tools.
- Gong integration is listed as coming soon.


*Source:*[Inventive AI G2 Reviews](https://www.g2.com/products/inventive-ai/reviews)


### **Steerlab**


**Strengths**


- AI drafts a number of ready to submit responses with minor edits, cutting the number of review cycles needed before submission.
- The AI cites its sources and flags uncertainty instead of generating a guess. Users say this makes the output trustworthy for high-stakes questionnaires.
- New team members get up to speed quickly. Users report minimal training is needed to start uploading docs and generating draft responses.
- Faster draft generation across RFPs and security questionnaires, users report shorter review cycles compared to manual processes.
- Handles the bulk of security questionnaires automatically. Users in presales report offloading repetitive SOC 2 and GDPR questions from their engineering teams.


**Limitations**


- AI response accuracy requires review. G2 users note that high-confidence AI answers are sometimes wrong or only close to correct, requiring manual verification before submission.
- Feature set has gaps. Users flag the absence of slide or presentation generation from completed responses, meaning client-facing summaries still require separate manual work.
- Workflow automation is incomplete. Reviewers cite missing features such as end-to-end workflow automation, with feature updates perceived as slow to ship.
- Export customization is limited. Users report that Word export has known bugs affecting formatting and version history, and export templates offer limited customization options.
- Not currently listed on Gartner Peer Insights.


*Source:*[Steerlab G2 Reviews](https://www.g2.com/products/steerlab/reviews)

## **FAQ**


### **Does Inventive AI or Steerlab train its AI on my company's content?**


Inventive AI does not train shared models on customer data. Your content stays isolated and is only used to generate responses within your own workspace. Steerlab's data usage policies are available on request. Worth confirming directly with their team before signing, especially if you handle sensitive product or legal content.


### **How long does it take to set up and start generating responses?**


Inventive AI connects to your existing sources (Confluence, Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, and others) during onboarding, so the knowledge base gets populated from content you already have. Steerlab's setup is built around uploading past proposals to seed the content library. Both tools can produce draft responses within the first session, though response quality improves as each system learns your content over time.


### **Can either tool handle DDQs and security questionnaires, or just RFPs?**


Both tools cover RFPs, RFIs, and[security questionnaires](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/vendor-assessment-questionnaire) . Inventive AI also handles DDQs as part of its core workflow. If your team regularly receives vendor security assessments alongside RFPs, confirm with each vendor which specific questionnaire formats and file types they support before shortlisting.


### **What happens when Inventive AI does not have an answer in the knowledge base?**


Inventive AI flags gaps where no matching content exists in the connected knowledge base instead of generating a fabricated response. Each AI-generated answer includes a source citation and confidence score, so reviewers can see exactly where the response came from and decide whether to approve, edit, or route it to an SME for input.


### **Does either tool integrate with Salesforce or HubSpot?**


Inventive AI has live integrations with both Salesforce and HubSpot, along with SharePoint, Google Drive, Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, and Okta. Steerlab integrates with productivity and document tools. Check their current integration list directly for CRM support, as this changes with product updates.


### **Which tool is a better fit for a small sales engineering team?**


Steerlab works well for smaller teams that need a fast way to reuse approved content across repetitive questionnaires without a large setup investment. Inventive AI is built to scale with teams handling a mix of RFPs, DDQs, and security questionnaires, and its agent-driven workflow reduces the coordination load that typically falls on a few people in smaller SE teams.
